```python
def _merge_heads(self, x: Tensor, batch_size: int, seq_len: int) -> Tensor:
    """Merge attention heads back into single embedding dimension.
    """
    x = x.transpose(1, 2)
    return x.reshape(batch_size, seq_len, self.embed_dim)
```
